verses.en: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.pt: Conhecido é Deus em Judá, grande é o seu nome em Israel.
verses.en_web: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Neginoth. A Psalm. Of Asaph. A Song.> In Judah is the knowledge of God; his name is great in Israel,

verses.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.pt: Em Salém está a sua tenda, e a sua morada em Sião.
verses.en_web: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
verses.en_bbe: In Salem is his tent, his resting-place in Zion.

verses.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.pt: Ali quebrou ele as flechas do arco, o escudo, a espada, e a guerra.
verses.en_web: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: There were the arrows of the bow broken, there he put an end to body-cover, sword, and fight. (Selah.)

verses.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.pt: Glorioso és tu, mais majestoso do que os montes eternos.
verses.en_web: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
verses.en_bbe: You are shining and full of glory, more than the eternal mountains.

verses.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.pt: Os ousados de coração foram despojados; dormiram o seu último sono; nenhum dos homens de força pôde usar as mãos.
verses.en_web: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
verses.en_bbe: Gone is the wealth of the strong, their last sleep has overcome them; the men of war have become feeble.

verses.en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.pt: Â tua repreensão, ó Deus de Jacó, cavaleiros e cavalos ficaram estirados sem sentidos.
verses.en_web: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.en_bbe: At the voice of your wrath, O God of Jacob, deep sleep has overcome carriage and horse.

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.pt: Tu, sim, tu és tremendo; e quem subsistirá à tua vista, quando te irares?
verses.en_web: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
verses.en_bbe: You, you are to be feared; who may keep his place before you in the time of your wrath?

verses.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.pt: Desde o céu fizeste ouvir o teu juízo; a terra tremeu e se aquietou,
verses.en_web: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
verses.en_bbe: From heaven you gave your decision; the earth, in its fear, gave no sound,

verses.en: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.pt: quando Deus se levantou para julgar, para salvar a todos os mansos da terra.
verses.en_web: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: When God took his place as judge, for the salvation of the poor on the earth. (Selah.)

verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.pt: Na verdade a cólera do homem redundará em teu louvor, e do restante da cólera tu te cingirás.
verses.en_web: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
verses.en_bbe: The ... will give you praise; the rest of ...

verses.en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.pt: Fazei votos, e pagai-os ao Senhor, vosso Deus; tragam presentes, os que estão em redor dele, àquele que deve ser temido.
verses.en_web: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
verses.en_bbe: Give to the Lord your God what is his by right; let all who are round him give offerings to him who is to be feared.

verses.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.pt: Ele ceifará o espírito dos príncipes; é tremendo para com os reis da terra.
verses.en_web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: He puts an end to the wrath of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
